accuiation , and torcibly bring both vs and our aſfes into bondage.
19. Whertore in the verie dore ſtepping to the ſteward ot the houſe,
thcy Ipake : Sir, we deſire thee to heare vg. Now once before we
came downe to buy prouiſion : 21. which being bought, when we were
come to the Inne, we opened our ſackes, and tound out money in the
mouths ot the ſackes: which we haue now brougnt againe in the ſame
weight. 22. But we haue brought other moncy beſides , to buy the things
that are neceſſarie tor vs: our conſcience is not priuie, Who put it in our
bags. 23. But he anſwered : Peace be with you, teare you not : your God,
and the God ot vout father hath giuen you treafures in your ſackes. Fot
the money, which you gaue me , I haue for good. And he brought
forth Simcon vnto them. 24. Aud being brought Into the houſe.
he fetched water, and they waſhed theit teet, and he gaue prouen-
der to theit aſſes. 25. But they made teadic the preſents
til Ioſeph ſhould come in at noone: for they had heard that they
